title: The Girl I Like Forgot Her Glasses
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shy middle schooler Kaede Komura has a crush on his deskmate Ai Mie, who keeps forgetting her glasses. He helps her through each school day, and her reliance on him slowly deepens both their feelings. Comikey publishes it digitally and Square Enix in print; age rating not confirmed (to verify).
life_message: It holds up small daily kindness and patience as the root of first love.

content.note: Innocent first-love tension, Ai leaning close to see Kaede's face (Wikipedia; MangaDex safe).
Kaede's fear of rejection and jealousy of Ren Azuma (Wikipedia).
Ai going without needed glasses is played as a gag (Wikipedia; AniList Disability tag).
